content.text:
Act as the implementation sub-agent for this task.

Make Moneo an installable PWA for phones and tablets. Repo: C:\Users\mgsuk\.t3\worktrees\Moneo\t3-bb40520b-1bab67392cb16a35 (Next.js 16 — read the relevant guides in node_modules/next/dist/docs/ first, especially on manifest, metadata/viewport and serving a service worker; and read AGENTS.md and follow it). Do not commit. Other agents are concurrently editing desktop/**, scripts/desktop/**, package.json, next.config.ts, lib/bank/return-listener.ts and app/setup/page.tsx — do NOT touch those.

Context: Moneo is a local-first personal finance app. Phones/tablets reach it privately through Tailscale Serve at https://<machine>.ts.net (lib/phone-access.ts, proxy.ts). app/manifest.ts and icons in public/ already exist. Financial data must never be cached offline on the device by the service worker (privacy), and the app must keep working normally when the server is reachable.

Do:
1. Audit installability for Chrome/Android and iOS/iPadOS Safari: manifest fields (id, name, icons incl. maskable, display, start_url, scope, theme/background colors matching light/dark), apple-touch-icon, `appleWebApp` metadata (capable, title, status bar style), viewport/theme-color for light and dark, safe-area insets so the standalone layout isn't hidden behind notches/home indicator (check the mobile layout chrome — bottom nav etc.).
2. Add a minimal service worker served at /sw.js with scope "/": network-only for everything (no caching of pages, API or data), plus a small static offline fallback page shown only when a navigation fails (e.g. "Moneo can't reach your computer — make sure it's on and Moneo is running", in plain words, light/dark). Register it from a tiny client component only in production and only on secure contexts; skip registration inside the Electron desktop app is unnecessary (harmless) but do make sure it never intercepts /api/*, /.well-known/workflow/*, /artifact-lib/* or non-GET requests. Make sure proxy.ts's matcher doesn't break /sw.js or the offline page (proxy.ts is yours to adjust only for that if required; keep Funnel refusal intact). Set headers so sw.js isn't cached stale (Cache-Control no-cache, Service-Worker-Allowed not needed for "/").
3. Verify with the QA server, never the owner's: follow e2e/README.md (`npm run setup -- --qa` if the moneo-qa stack isn't up, `npm run qa:auth`, `npm run qa:server` on port 3100). Check with Playwright (mobile viewport, e.g. iPhone and Pixel device descriptors) that manifest is served and valid, the SW registers and activates on localhost, pages and /api requests are not served from cache (go offline via context.setOffline and confirm a navigation shows the offline page while no financial page HTML is retrievable from Cache Storage — caches should contain only the offline page and its assets). Take before/after screenshots of the mobile layout in light and dark into the scratchpad C:\Users\mgsuk\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\cc74f73eb1c8553d\c8cff258-d219-492d-b62f-e613ed42492f\scratchpad\pwa\. If an existing e2e journey is the natural home, extend it for SW+offline behaviour rather than writing a new spec; only add a spec if none fits (AGENTS.md Tests rules).
4. Run `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm test` (and the e2e spec you touched). Stop the qa:server you started (only your own PID).

Report: files changed, what you verified and how, screenshot paths, and remaining gaps (e.g. iOS can't be tested here). Never claim something passed that you didn't run.

README.md accessibility.gated.spec.ts action-preview.gated.spec.ts artifact-card-sliders.gated.spec.ts artifact-home.gated.spec.ts artifact-page-protection.mocked.spec.ts bad-links.gated.spec.ts chat-background.gated.spec.ts chat-cancel.gated.spec.ts core-journey.smoke.spec.ts fixtures.ts global-setup.ts home-dashboard.gated.spec.ts home-performance.gated.spec.ts import-control.gated.spec.ts import-control.mocked.spec.ts import-journey.mocked.spec.ts mocks net-worth-chat.provider.spec.ts net-worth.gated.spec.ts review-investigation.config.ts review-investigation.integration.ts review-runtime.config.ts review-runtime.integration.ts scalable-trading.provider.spec.ts service-keys.mocked.spec.ts theme-contrast.gated.spec.ts two-user-isolation.gated.spec.ts # Browser tests Playwright tests run against the separate test backend (Docker project `moneo-qa`, `.env.qa`) and this checkout's app on http://localhost:3100. The config starts the app with `npm run qa:server` (or a production build with `E2E_PRODUCTION_BUILD=1`) unless it is already running. ## Setup 1. Create the test backend once (and after pulling new migrations): `npm run setup -- --qa`. 2. Create the QA user and save its session: `npm run qa:auth`. Its login is stored in `.env.qa` as `E2E_USER_EMAIL`/`E2E_USER_PASSWORD`, and its session in `e2e/.auth.json` (or set `E2E_STORAGE_STATE`). 3. Before a full run, empty its workspace: `npm run qa:reset`. The whole test backend is disposable: `docker compose -p moneo-qa down -v` and step 1 start it fresh. The owner's `moneo` project is never touched. Tests never use the owner's workspace. Every spec runs with the saved QA session and an `x-moneo-test` header; with that header the app refuses a request that has no valid session instead of signing the owner in (`proxy.ts`). Before any spec runs, `e2e/global-setup.ts` checks that the server under test does this, so an older or foreign server on the port stops the run. ## Running ```sh npm run test:e2e -- --workers=1 ``` Use one worker: several specs change the same QA workspace and its preferences. The QA server builds into `.next-qa`, so it can run beside `npm run dev`. ## Kinds of specs - `*.smoke.spec.ts` and `*.mocked.spec.ts` stub or skip the backend. Against a configured backend they still need the QA session, like every spec. - `*.gated.spec.ts` need the backend. Most use the QA session; others create disposable users with the service key, sign them in by session cookie, and remove them in `finally`. If interrupted, their IDs are left in ignored `.qa/` files for cleanup. - `*.provider.spec.ts` call the real AI model, so they cost money. They run only with `E2E_REAL_AI=1`; `npm run test:e2e` leaves them out. - `review-runtime.config.ts` and `review-investigation.config.ts` run the real Workflow engine against local synthetic database and model servers (ports 3040/3041), including a server restart mid-review: `npx playwright test --config e2e/review-runtime.config.ts`. ## Nightly `npm run qa:nightly -- --install` schedules the whole suite for 03:00 every day (a Windows scheduled task that starts as soon as possible if the PC was off). It runs every spec twice on a production build of `origin/main`, in its own worktree in `~/.moneo/nightly`, and keeps one GitHub issue, "Nightly browser suite is failing", up to date. A night with Docker off or port 3100 busy is skipped quietly; the log is `~/.moneo/nightly.log`. A skipped spec is not a pass: it means a prerequisite (backend, QA session, service key) is missing. ## Scalable `scalable-trading.provider.spec.ts` drives chat against a local stand-in for Scalable's MCP server (`e2e/mocks/scalable-mcp.mjs`, made-up data) with the real AI model. Start `npm run qa:server` with `SCALABLE_MCP_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:3043` (and the AI key in `.env.qa`) and run the spec with the same variable and `E2E_REAL_AI=1`; the spec starts the stand-in, adds a Scalable connection to the QA workspace and removes it afterwards. It checks that an order is previewed on a card and sent only when the card is tapped, once, and that read-only access is told it can't trade.

content.text:
Moneo is now an installable PWA with a network-only service worker. Nothing is committed. Typecheck, lint (including `check:privacy`) and `npm test` pass (1543 passed, 10 skipped). I did not re-run the e2e spec after the last edit, which was only a README line.

## Files changed
- **New:** `public/sw.js`, `public/offline.html`, `components/service-worker.tsx`.
- **Edited:** `app/layout.tsx`, `app/manifest.ts`, `proxy.ts`, `app/globals.css`, `components/app-shell.tsx`, `e2e/core-journey.smoke.spec.ts`, `README.md`.

## What changed
- **Service worker (`/sw.js`, scope `/`):** it only handles GET navigations. If one fails, or the server answers 502/503/504 (what Tailscale returns when Moneo isn't running), it shows the offline page. It never touches `/api/`, `/.well-known/`, `/artifact-lib/`, non-GET requests or non-navigation requests. The only thing it caches is `offline.html`.
- **Offline page:** plain-words message with a "Try again" button, light and dark, with safe-area padding.
- **Registration:** `ServiceWorker` registers it only in production on secure contexts.
- **Cache headers:** Next already serves `public/` files with `Cache-Control: public, max-age=0`, so I added no header config. I left `next.config.ts` alone as asked.
- **Manifest:** added `id: "/"` and `categories: ["finance"]`. It already had the name, `start_url`, `scope`, `display: standalone`, and 192, 512 and maskable icons.
- **Theme colour:** now follows light and dark (`#f4f3ee` and `#0f1011`). The manifest's own `theme_color` and `background_color` stay `#0f1011`, since it can't do both.
- **Safe-area insets:** the header gets top padding, and the body and mobile bottom nav get left and right padding for landscape notches. The bottom inset was already handled.
- **`proxy.ts`:** the matcher now skips `sw.js` and `offline.html`, like the existing image exclusions. The Funnel refusal still applies to everything else. Those two static files are now served without the Funnel check.
- **README:** one sentence in the phone access section saying the phone never keeps your numbers.

## What I verified
- **E2E spec:** I extended `e2e/core-journey.smoke.spec.ts` with one test that checks the manifest, registers the worker, goes offline, and confirms the offline page and a failed `/api/health`. It passed on the dev server. I made the worker cache pages on purpose and the test failed, then restored the file.
- **Production build on the QA server (port 3100), iPhone 14 and Pixel 7, light and dark:**
  - The worker registers from the app and activates with scope `/`.
  - Cache Storage held only `/offline.html`.
  - Offline, `/money/accounts` showed the offline page and `/api/health` failed.
  - The head has theme-color for light and dark, the manifest link, `apple-touch-icon`, and the apple web-app tags (capable, title, status bar `default`).
- **Cleanup:** I stopped my own QA server and port 3100 is free. I did not reconfirm every PID: the process on the port didn't show the worktree path in its command line, so I stopped the `qa-server.mjs` wrapper I had started, and the port then showed free.

## Screenshots
Files are in `C:\Users\mgsuk\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\cc74f73eb1c8553d\c8cff258-d219-492d-b62f-e613ed42492f\scratchpad\pwa\`:
- `before-{iphone,pixel}-{light,dark}.png`
- `after-{iphone,pixel}-{light,dark}.png`
- `offline-{iphone,pixel}-{light,dark}.png`

I looked at `offline-iphone-dark.png` and `after-iphone-light.png`, and the layout looks unchanged. I did not open the other ten.

## Gaps
- **iOS and iPadOS Safari weren't tested.** Chromium can't emulate the notch or home indicator, so the safe-area changes are untested. The insets are 0 in emulation, so the before and after screenshots match.
- **Status bar and theme-color follow the OS, not Moneo's own theme setting.** A user who picks dark in Moneo on a light phone gets a light bar.
- **Splash background is always dark.** The manifest only allows one colour.
- **In dev, the worker only registers if you register it by hand.** The spec does this itself.
